name: @partops/mobile
description: Cáscara Android de PartOps (Capacitor). La app carga la web publicada; sin conexión muestra un respaldo local.

scripts.build:apk: node scripts/build-mobile-shell.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease -PversionName=%npm_package_version%
scripts.build:apk:unix: node scripts/build-mobile-shell.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PversionName=$npm_package_version
